title: Define the MVP and record client-side platform access
body:
Goal: the agreed MVP scope and the architecture change are written down before the M2 roadmap.
Acceptance: `docs/milestone2-mvp.md` holds decisions D1-D24, the MAL API findings and the Google sign-in and Play findings; `docs/future-features.md` lists the parked ideas with the decision each came from; ADR 0007 (client-side platform access) is accepted and listed in `docs/decisions/README.md` and the root README; CLAUDE.md and the README replace the rule that only the server talks to MAL (module list, architecture diagram, Auth section); `docs/tickets-m2.csv` holds the M2 prep tickets; relative links resolve.
Out of scope: skill changes (M2-0c), agent changes (M2-0a, M2-0b), the M2 roadmap.
Skill: adr, ticket-workflow.

title: Rewrite the existing agents with project knowledge
body:
Goal: the six agents in `.claude/agents/` know this project, so the main session gets useful, compact output instead of generic answers.
Acceptance: every agent has a `description` saying when to use it, `tools`, `model`, `skills:` (only skills it needs on every call), a body with the project facts it cannot guess, a fixed report format, and the hard rules (no commits or pushes, `git add` new files, never spawn agents, stay in the given scope). Per agent:
- `Explore` (haiku; Read, Grep, Glob; skill codebase-overview): module map, package convention `com.greenzean.animekmp.<module>.<feature>`, where the SDL, SQLDelight `.sq` files, Flyway migrations, Koin modules and ADRs live. Answer: a direct answer, then at most ~15 `path:line` hits, no file dumps, a plain not found when nothing matches.
- `build-runner` (haiku; Bash, Read): command table matching CI (lint `./gradlew spotlessCheck detekt`; Android `./gradlew :androidApp:assembleDebug :shared:allTests`; server `./gradlew :server:build`, which needs Docker for Testcontainers, say so if it is down; schema `./gradlew :server:test -PupdateSchema`). Plain `./gradlew` commands without pipes so the gradle-filter hook trims output. On failure, read `build/reports/tests/` or the detekt reports for the cause. Report PASS/FAIL per task, then per failure the task, test, `file:line`, a 1-3 line error and the likely cause. Never edit files or run `spotlessApply` unless asked.
- `docs` (haiku; Read, Write, Edit; skills adr, ticket-workflow): doc types and their formats: ADRs (template, numbering, index and README links, status), ticket text (Goal, Depends on, Acceptance, Out of scope, Skill; CSV columns as in `docs/tickets-m0-m1.csv`), README sections, `docs/milestone2-mvp.md` and `docs/future-features.md` (D-numbers). Short sentences, tables for comparisons. Never invent decisions, versions or URLs; list gaps under Missing.
- `researcher` (sonnet; Read, WebSearch, WebFetch): stack context (KMP/CMP, AGP 9, Ktor, graphql-kotlin, Apollo Kotlin, SQLDelight, Koin, Exposed, Flyway, Postgres, MAL API v2, Google Credential Manager). Source priority: official docs and release notes, then Maven Central or Google Maven, then GitHub releases; blogs never as the primary source. Versions: newest stable at least two weeks old, with its release date. Output per question: answer, URL, checked date, confidence (read directly, from a summary, unverified), ready to paste into an ADR Context.
- `reviewer` (opus, high; Read, Grep, Glob, Bash; skills ticket-workflow, codebase-overview): steps `gh issue view <n>`, `git diff main...HEAD` plus uncommitted changes, check every acceptance criterion and out-of-scope item; check the CLAUDE.md code rules, ADR 0007, scope to the named modules, tests in `commonTest` and the server, SDL committed and in sync, ADR written when a decision changed. Output: verdict, criteria checklist (met, not met, not verifiable), findings by severity with `path:line`. Bash only for read-only git and gh.
- `security-reviewer` (opus, high; Read, Grep, Glob; skill sync-protocol): threat model for this repo: public repo and untrusted client; ADR 0007 (MAL tokens only on the device in Keystore-backed storage, no platform tokens or platform user data on the server); Google ID token checks (signature, `aud` = web client ID, `iss`, `exp`, nonce, users keyed on `sub`); our session tokens; per-user authorization in every resolver (user ID from the token, never from input); GraphQL depth, complexity and batch-size limits; `pushChanges` input validation; secrets, `.env` and keystores; CI on fork PRs; MAL agreement limits (no stored credentials, privacy policy); Play account deletion. Output: findings with severity, `path:line`, exploit scenario and fix.
Verified: every frontmatter parses, tool names exist and each `skills:` entry matches a folder in `.claude/skills/`; smoke runs of `Explore` (where is the pull cursor stored?), `build-runner` (lint only) and `docs` (format a one-line test ticket without writing a file) follow their report formats.
Out of scope: new agents (M2-0b), changes to skills, settings or hooks.
Skill: ticket-workflow.

title: Create the area agents
body:
Goal: the area agents planned in CLAUDE.md exist, so large M2 features can be split by module.
Depends on: M2-0a (reuses its hard rules and report format).
Acceptance: five agents, all sonnet with tools Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash. Common body: implement only the given part of a ticket inside the agent's module(s) and report anything outside instead of changing it; follow the preloaded skills and the ADRs; run the module's tests and `./gradlew spotlessCheck detekt` itself with plain `./gradlew` (subagents cannot call build-runner); `git add` new files; no commits or pushes; never spawn agents. Report: files changed, tests run and their result, deviations from the plan, open questions. Per agent:
- `server` (skills ktor-server-conventions, postgres-migrations, graphql-schema, sync-protocol): `server/` only. Schema changes go server first; the SDL is regenerated with `./gradlew :server:test -PupdateSchema`, never edited by hand. Never calls MAL (ADR 0007). Tests: `:server:test`.
- `shared-kmp` (skills kmp-data-layer, kmp-error-handling, kmp-di-koin, sync-protocol, graphql-schema): `shared/` (`commonMain` and platform `actual`s), plus `androidApp/` only for platform wiring such as WorkManager. The MAL client lives here, with tokens behind a secure-storage interface. Tests: `:shared:allTests`.
- `compose-ui` (skills kmp-compose-ui, kmp-presentation-mvi, kmp-navigation): `composeApp/` only. Uses the view model interface it is given and reports needed view model changes instead of making them. Previews and accessibility. Build: `:androidApp:assembleDebug`.
- `tester` (skills kmp-testing, postgres-migrations): writes and fixes tests only (`commonTest`, `server/src/test`); fakes over mocks, Testcontainers for the database. Does not change production code; reports bugs it finds.
- `build-ci` (skill kmp-module-structure): `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, the `build.gradle.kts` files, `.github/workflows/`, `config/detekt`, `.editorconfig`, `docker-compose.yml`, `Dockerfile`. Every version change comes with a source and release date; no secrets in workflows; fork PRs get no secrets.
- `CLAUDE.md` Delegation updated: the area agents exist; keep only for large features and the feature order; add that area agents run their own Gradle checks.
Verified: every frontmatter parses, tool names exist and each `skills:` entry matches a folder in `.claude/skills/`; after a session restart `/agents` lists all 11 project agents.
Out of scope: changes to the existing six agents (M2-0a), skills, settings or hooks.
Skill: ticket-workflow, kmp-module-structure.

title: Align skills with ADR 0007
body:
Goal: the skills stop saying that the server talks to MAL, matching ADR 0007.
Depends on: M2-0 (ADR 0007).
Acceptance: `codebase-overview`: `shared/` lists the MAL client and says only the app talks to MAL; `server/` says it syncs libraries between a user's devices, never calls MAL and stores no platform tokens, platform user data or anime metadata; `docs/` mentions `milestone2-mvp.md`. `kmp-module-structure`: the module tree shows the MAL client in `shared/` and no MAL adapter in `server/`. `ktor-server-conventions`: the intro rule matches ADR 0007, and the not-decided-yet note names auth (Google ID token verification, session tokens) instead of the MAL adapter. `grep -rn 'MAL adapter\|talks to MAL' .claude/` finds no old-rule text.
Out of scope: agents (M2-0a, M2-0b), other skills.
Skill: codebase-overview, kmp-module-structure, ktor-server-conventions.
